search_window.basis: Interval since the last independently read-back verified Food Line heartbeat; October 27-28 reporting examined with overlap for late indexing.

coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value recall watch only; primary nationwide production collection remains authoritative. No editorial approvals, publication, social posting, schedule changes, or task disabling.

Exactly 12 targeted web searches: three for sole/last/full-service grocery closures, fires or losses; three for disaster/outage-related emergency food distribution cancellation or suspension; three for abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major service reduction; and three for newly official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions.

No newly verified qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified in the bounded window. Search results are not evidence of nationwide absence, and very recent local items may not yet be indexed.

KPCW's October 27 coverage of Community Action Services' Heber City, Utah pantry reports a planned end-of-November closure, not a new immediate loss during this window; earlier watches also identified Utah pantry disruptions. Excluded as already known and outside immediate-impact window. Source: https://www.kpcw.org/wasatch-county/2026-10-27/provo-based-food-bank-closing-heber-location-after-loss-of-federal-funding

Kaua'i Now's October 27 Hurricane Lowell recovery update advertises emergency food distributions on October 27 and October 30; it does not announce a food distribution cancellation. Excluded. Source: https://kauainownews.com/2026/10/27/what-kaua%CA%BBi-county-residents-visitors-need-to-know-thursday-about-hurricane-lowell-recovery/
Previously surfaced October 27 Wymore, Nebraska last-grocery loss and October 26 South Philadelphia Community Fridge food pantry fire were already handed off and not counted again.

Search results prominently recycled October 2025 federal-shutdown SNAP interruption warnings, historical grocery fires, food-resource guides, donation appeals and routine program stories. None established a newly official October 28, 2026 assistance interruption with immediate consequences.

All targeted search calls completed and inspected direct reporting for relevant candidates; no material request failure was observed. Search-index date matching is imperfect and the watch cannot guarantee every local notice.
